messages:
marta: Quick handoff — I'm stepping off in ~25m. Main things: encoder-pool-7 still flaps when sustained QPS > 850, prefetched KV misses spike in eu-west during nightly build jobs. Leaving a short watchlist below. :wave:

sam: thx! adding to my checklist. can you paste the quick mitigation steps?

marta: sure — short list:
- avoid node draining in eu-west between 02:00-04:00 UTC
- if encoder-pool-7 enters Throttled state, escalate to eng-runtime
- temp workaround: set PREFETCH_WINDOW=0.6 for the pod group (see command)

marta: command:
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/encoder-pool PREFETCH_WINDOW=0.6
```

lee: noted. any noisy alerts we should suppress? 'encoder_high_cpu' has fired ~6x today but it's mostly backlog-related short bursts.

marta: yep — encoder_high_cpu severity=info should be suppressed for <5min bursts. filed PR for alert tweak: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/432 

anjali: FYI - prefetch KV misses correlate with the nightly data-load job at 01:30 UTC. if we see miss rate >0.12, expect tail latency increase ~20-30ms.

oncall-bot: Rotation reminder — sam is oncall tonight starting 23:00 UTC. :bell:

sam: got it. I'll watch the prefetch metric and the canary. ping me @sam if encoder-pool-7 flaps.

lee: small FYI — don't restart redis-cache-eu unless you confirm replication lag < 2s. restarting caused a failover spike last week.

marta: added playbook links: https://redwood.infra/playbooks/encoder-flap and https://redwood.infra/playbooks/kv-prefetch

sam: taking notes. any pending code review pings I should handle before swap?

marta: please LGTM #1284 (canary rollback policy) and comment on #1291 (batching tuning) if you can.

anjali: leaving a quick check: observability traces for canary show a single anomalous host that spikes CPU. Host id: host-3f9. I recommended cordon+drain if it reappears.

sam: ok will keep host-3f9 quarantined. thanks everyone, I'll post an update if anything changes. :eyes:
